items.t: Brake booster housing can rust through (recall)
Driver's airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
Diesel fuel filter can leak (recall)
Active Curve System oil can foam and leak (recall)
Emergency call system may send the wrong location (recall)
Passenger airbag may switch off for an adult (recall)
Water can knock out power steering assist (recall)
Airbags may not deploy correctly due to software (recall)
Emergency call system can stop working from a SIM software error (recall)
Backup camera can show no picture (recall)
48-volt ground connection under the passenger seat can overheat (recall)
Engine can stall when the transmission doesn't downshift (recall)
Third-row seatbacks may not lock in a crash (recall)
Rear door window trim can come off while driving (recall)
A/C drain hoses can leak water into the cabin (recall)
Fuel pump can shut down and cut power (recall)
Windshield camera and mirror can come loose (recall)
Airmatic air suspension sags and the compressor wears out
items.job: Replace leaking air strut and air suspension compressor
items.note: One owner spent about $5,000 total on struts, a rear air spring and the compressor. Aftermarket parts cost less.

items.t: 7-speed automatic slips, hesitates or gets stuck in gear
items.job: Replace and program the transmission conductor plate
items.note: Owners report about $1,000-2,200. A full transmission costs much more.

items.t: Transfer case chain stretches and clunks
items.job: Replace transfer case chain (or remanufactured transfer case)
items.note: The chain alone is about $100-150; a remanufactured case runs $3,000-4,000 installed.

items.t: Worn idler gear throws off engine timing
items.job: Replace idler gear and timing chain
items.note: Usually needs the engine removed. One owner was quoted $3,600.

items.t: Water leaks damage the SAM control modules
items.job: Seal water leak and replace SAM module
items.note: Severe corrosion across several modules and wiring can cost far more.

items.t: Coolant leaks from hoses, pump and radiator
items.job: Replace leaking coolant hose, line or radiator

items.t: Door handles and lock actuators stop working
items.job: Replace door handle or door lock actuator

items.t: Secondary air pump fails on start-up
items.note: Check the relay and fuse first; they cost a few dollars.

items.t: Front suspension bushings and links wear and clunk
items.job: Replace front control arms and sway bar links, then align
items.note: One owner paid about $1,340 for both upper arms with alignment.

items.t: Diesel emissions settlement repair and extended warranty
items.job: Emissions software update and NOx parts under settlement
items.note: Covered by the 2020 settlement, not an NHTSA recall.

items.t: Timing chain rattle for a few seconds on a cold start
items.job: Replace timing chain tensioners and check valves
items.note: Dealers charge about $1,500. Cost rises if the chain or cam adjusters also need replacing.

items.t: Cylinder walls get scored, causing knocking and oil burning
items.note: Rough guide only; one owner was quoted $37,000 for a dealer engine replacement.

items.t: Oil wicks from cam sensors into the engine wiring
items.job: Replace camshaft sensors and clean or replace oil-soaked wiring
items.note: Catching it early costs a few hundred dollars; owners report $4,000-7,500 once the harness and computer are damaged.

items.t: Steering wheel shakes when braking from highway speed
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors

items.t: Harsh or lumpy downshifts when slowing down
